{{ letter_head }}
Disciplinary Investigation Form – Root Cause Analysis
Section A: Case Information

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name or "" }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee or "" }}

Employee Position: {{ doc.job_title or "" }}

Department: {{ doc.department or "" }}

Reported By: {{ doc.reported_by or "" }}

Date: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.date) if doc.date else "" }}

Section B: Incident Description

Nature of Misconduct/Issue: {{ doc.nature_of_misconduct_issue or "" }}

Location of Incident: {{ doc.location_of_incident or "" }}

Date of Incident: {{ doc.date_of_incident or "" }}

Witnesses (if any): {{ doc.witnesses_if_any or "" }}

Initial Evidence Collected: {{ doc.initial_evidence_collected or "" }}

Section C: Investigation Committee

Chairperson: {{ doc.chairperson or "" }}

HR Manager: {{ doc.hr_manager or "" }}

Line Manager/Supervisor: {{ doc.line_manager_supervisor or "" }}

Committee Member 1: {{ doc.committee_member_1 or "" }}

Committee Member 2: {{ doc.committee_member_2 or "" }}

Committee Member 3: {{ doc.committee_member_3 or "" }}

Section D: Root Cause Analysis
1. Problem Statement (Clearly describe the misconduct/performance issue)
{{ doc.problem_statement or "" }}
2. Immediate Causes (What happened?)
{{ doc.immediate_causes or "" }}
3. Underlying Causes (Why did it happen?)
{{ doc.underlying_causes or "" }}
4. Root Cause (Fundamental reason)
{{ doc.root_cause or "" }}
Section E: Corrective & Preventive Actions

Corrective Action (short‑term fix): {{ doc.corrective_action or "" }}

Responsible Person(s): {{ doc.responsible_person or "" }}

Preventive Action (long‑term solution): {{ doc.preventive_action or "" }}

Timeline for Implementation: {{ doc.timeline_for_implementation or "" }}

Section F: Committee Decision
Verbal Warning {{ "☑" if doc.committee_decision == "Verbal Warning" else "☐" }} Written Warning {{ "☑" if doc.committee_decision == "Written Warning" else "☐" }} Final Written Warning {{ "☑" if doc.committee_decision == "Final Written Warning" else "☐" }} Suspension {{ "☑" if doc.committee_decision == "Suspension" else "☐" }} Termination {{ "☑" if doc.committee_decision == "Termination" else "☐" }} Other (specify): {{ "☑" if doc.committee_decision == "Other" else "☐" }} {{ doc.if_other_specify or "" }}
Section G: Employee Rights
Employee informed of allegations {{ "☑" if doc.employee_rights == "Employee informed of allegations" else "☐" }} Employee given chance to respond {{ "☑" if doc.employee_rights == "Employee given chance to respond" else "☐" }} Employee appeal rights explained {{ "☑" if doc.employee_rights == "Employee appeal rights explained" else "☐" }}
Section H: Signatures
Chairperson:      Date:   Member:      Date:  
HR Manager:      Date:   Employee:      Date:
name: Disciplinary Investigation Form
